description: Returns the signed-in partner's own credit-line statement: `balance` (the real-time balance due and pending, ALWAYS for the whole credit line, not filtered by the dates), `account` details (name, currency, creditLimit, periodType), and the booking rows whose due date falls between `from` and `to` (default: the current month; at most 93 days). Each row carries `bookingReferenceId`, `hotelName`, `guestName`, dates, `amount`, `currency`, `bucket` (`current` = due, `pending` = not due yet), `dueDate`, `paid`, `outstanding`, `paymentStatus`, `settledBy`, and `lineType` (`booking`, or `cancellation_fee` for a late-cancellation charge). Read-only. Needs a signed-in partner credit-line account session; guest sessions have no credit line. Takes no account identifier: the credit line is always the caller's own.

from.description: First due date to include, YYYY-MM-DD. Pass with `to`; omit both for the current month.

to.description: Last due date to include, YYYY-MM-DD (at most 93 days after `from`).

name: get_credit_line_statement
title: Get Credit-Line Statement
